issues.description: In Exercise 1 the problem text and template docstring indicate the simulate method should return the statevector, but the template's type annotation for simulate is dict[str, int] (suggesting measurement counts). The provided solution returns a statevector (list[complex]). This mismatch between the template signature and the intended behavior (and solution) can confuse students about what to implement and what the method should return.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template method signature and its docstring consistent with the intended return value. Either (A) change the template simulate type annotation to return the statevector type (e.g. list[complex] or Statevector) and update the docstring to reflect returning the statevector, matching the solution; or (B) if counts were intended, update the problem text and solution to request/return measurement counts. Prefer option (A) to match the exercise description that asks for the statevector.
